note: Embedding vectors for the committed fixture corpus, generated once so that ingesting data/fixtures/ twice produces the same vectors and not merely the same text. The embedding endpoint does not return bit-identical vectors for identical input — measured at 99-141 of 284 rows differing on every pair of ingests. Keyed by a SHA-256 over the embedding model, the dimension count and the exact embedded string (context prefix + content), so an edited chunk or a changed model misses rather than reusing a vector from another text or another embedding space. Regenerate with `make embedding-cache`.
